en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a historic central-European town square dominated by a large Gothic/Renaissance building with a very steep tiled roof and several stepped gables. The façade has arched doorways, a balcony, a small clock on one of the central gables, and signage at ground level. To the left is a row of multi‑storey townhouses with shops at street level, and a cobblestone square with a few pedestrians in front.
